$comment: Suppress known/reviewed failures from the flaky-test report. `suppressions` silences a specific test (file + context + it). `runSuppressions` excludes an entire CI run by commit SHA — use when an environment outage compromises all stats for a run.

suppressions.it: InventoryPage.STANDARD: Then name ascending sorting option is marked as chosen
suppressions.reason: Cypress 16 changed its visibility algorithm to use the browser-native Element.checkVisibility() API. Under this API, <option> elements inside a native <select> dropdown are never considered "visible" — because the browser renders them in a native OS-level popup, not as normal laid-out DOM. Even though the computed styles look visible (display: block, visibility: visible, etc.), checkVisibility() returns false, so .should('be.visible') now fails.
suppressions.context: InventoryPage: Given STANDARD user on Inventory page, no products are added to cart > InventoryPage.STANDARD: When user clicks on sorting dropdown
